title: Fun day in Costa Brava & Dali Museum
text: Our guide, Antwan, was very personable and informative. He is an excellent driver and made the day fun and enlightening.

author: Q1660NQruthm

title: Great Tour - I would recommend
text: My Family loved this tour, all 3 of the places we visited were enjoyed.  The first town was adorable and had great muffins (don't miss the muffins - peach was our favorite).  The Dali Museum was fantastic, I easily could have spent more time there.  And the beach town a perfect way to end our day and our trip to Spain.  The only caveat I would say is it is a lot of driving - making the tour a long day but I'd do it again and it was a pleasure to spend the day with William; he is a great guide.
author: Q81EHamyl

title: An unmissable tour to do with time and a desire to be amazed
text: The tour was pleasant, especially due to the good disposition of the guide, who, in addition to being friendly, was an expert connoisseur
author: Graciela_S

title: The Dali museum is worth...
text: The Dali museum is worth the trip from Barcelona! The other stops were also great. Guillome our tour guide was also very knowledgeable about EVERYTHING!
author: Harry_S

title: Wonderful Day tour with Fabrizio!
text: Fabrizio was wonderful.  He had great energy, knowledge of the Costa Brava region as well as Salvatore Dali.  He listened attentively to our requests and was great with our younger kids. We nightly recommend him for a tour of Barcelona and other areas outside the city center!  His English and Spanish were amazing!
author: Maria_M

title: Fabulous, full day
text: Incredible day with Guilio seeing the beauty of Spain outside Barcelona. Great chance to have a knowledgeable guide bring you to the beachside and to Dalí’s hometown and theatre/museum. Such a full experience. Loved it!
author: Courtney_B

title: Low season best season
text: All the three villages we visited were amazing and the Dali museum was a plus to an already beautifull day!
author: anagP6433PK

title: Top
text: How nice it is to get out of town to visit the costa brava, the medieval village in a small bus between us. Away from the tourist clusters we spent a wonderful day with Guillaume which was a mine of explanations and culture. The Dali Museum is amazing. This day was a small one in our stay.
author: marinaw926

title: Best tour guide
text: Guilio was great!! Super friendly and knowledgeable on all our stops. Had great suggestions for other places to visit and restaurants to check out.
author: Leonor_F
